children: Teucrium has delayed the launch of its short XRP ETF for the 19th time, pushing the earliest possible start to October 11, 2026. The fund is designed to profit when XRP falls, while its long XRP counterpart has traded since April 2025, according to BeInCrypto, and the latest SEC filing gives no explanation for the delay. XRP peaked at $3.65 in July 2025 and now trades near $1.37.

title: Teucrium Delays Short XRP ETF Launch To October 11, 2026
